title: Links between a change's files, and a steadier macOS app
summary: A link in an artifact to another file of the same change — `[design](./design.md)` in a proposal — now opens that file in the change's view. In the macOS app, Retry after a port change moves the window to the new port, a link that asks for a new tab opens in your browser instead of replacing the window, and quitting never leaves the server it started running.
